Title: Rajesh's Day

Cast

1. Rajesh - 28 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Shalini - 25 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Sunita - 63 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Anil - 34 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
5. Pallavi - 27 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The bazaar - fruit stalls, a crowd
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Shalini stands in the kitchen. Rajesh, Sunita and Anil stand near her.]

Shalini: "What lovely weather!"

[Shalini rolls out rotis on the board.]

Shalini: "Rajesh, listen!"

[Shalini stirs the dal in the pot.]

Rajesh (surprised): "That was fun!"

[Rajesh cuts his finger while chopping onions and it starts to bleed.]

Anil: "Shalini, look at this."

[The knife slips and Rajesh's hand is cut; blood drips onto the floor.]

Rajesh (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rajesh winces as blood trickles from the cut on his thumb.]

Rajesh (happily): "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The bazaar - Day

[Rajesh stands in the bazaar. Sunita and Shalini stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Let's begin."

[Rajesh chases the thief through the crowd.]

Rajesh (laughing): "Yes, all right."

[Rajesh shouts for help.]

Rajesh: "Oh wow!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Rajesh: "So, here we are!"

[Rajesh wraps a bandage around his bleeding hand.]

Rajesh: "Okay, Pallavi."

[Rajesh presses a cloth to the wound to stop the bleeding.]

Rajesh (gently): "What next?"

Scene 4: The main road - Day

[Rajesh stands on the road. Sunita and Anil stand near him.]

Sunita: "What a nice place."

[Rajesh starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Rajesh: "Exactly right."

[Rajesh is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Rajesh: "Anil, listen!"

[Rajesh's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Anil: "Yes, of course."

[Rajesh loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Anil: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rajesh is killed when a truck hits him.]

Anil (gently): "We will never forget you."
